findings.finding: A separate 200ms postsettlement timeout is an unsupported new prospective threshold. Original absolute90s already bounds the single-next-existing-interval hold; a new 200ms gate is unnecessary to the delegated design scope.
findings.requestedCorrection: Use the original absolute90s deadline, release after exactly the first existing scheduled sweep regardless of result, and state that100ms cadence is not a maximum wall delay.

notes: Synthetic model cannot prove Node timer cadence, process-read completeness, normal child exit, or no forced shutdown; actual frozen cleanup validator remains responsible for evidence details.
